chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn, from al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from Sama'ah, from Abi Basir, who said:

I asked him about banishment from the land: how is it? He said: “He is banished from all the lands of Islam. If he is apprehended in any part of the land of Islam, he is killed, and there is no amān for him until he joins the land of shirk.”

key_terms.أَرْضِ الشِّرْكِ: the land of shirk, meaning non-Islamic territory in this context
key_terms.الْإِنْفَاءِ: banishment or expulsion from the land
key_terms.بِلَادِ الْإِسْلَامِ: the territories under Islam from which the person is expelled

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe banishment from the lands of Islam for an apostate?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a legal ruling concerning banishment from Islamic lands in the context of the chapter on the apostate male and female. It states that such a person is to be expelled from all the lands of Islam, and if found within them, he is to be killed and granted no amān until he reaches the land of shirk.
